scripts.db:migrate: dotnet tool restore && dotnet ef database update --project src/FootballManager.Infrastructure --startup-project src/FootballManager.Infrastructure
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run api" "npm run worker" "npm run web"
scripts.build: dotnet build FootballManager.slnx && npm --prefix apps/web run build
